summary: SOCRadar Supply Chain Intelligence: an outside-in assessment of suppliers’ and partners’ cybersecurity, with a profile, trust score and findings.
value: It shows which suppliers an attacker could use to reach the company.
Supplier risk is assessed without questionnaires and waiting for answers.
New supplier problems are spotted in time.
simple: Assesses the cybersecurity of your suppliers and partners from the outside: a profile of each supplier, a trust score (Security Trust Score), findings from the latest scan — attack surface, brand impersonation, threat intelligence and the dark web. Maps risks to standards and requirements, shows how fast they are being remediated, prepares reports (including under your own brand), analyzes news about suppliers with AI and alerts you to new risks. One license — all capabilities.
classification: One licence, all capabilities; the TPRM class was created for SOCRadar.
